DesktopDiag|claude-skill.description: Claude Code skill: ask "check my PC" and Claude reads your Windows logs and disks (read-only), explains blue screens, GPU driver resets, SSD wear and hardware errors, scores your PC and schedules follow-up checks. English or French.

DesktopDiag|windows-app.description: Portable Windows app (1 MB, nothing to install): one-click PC health check with a score out of 100, step-by-step advice, optional deep scan (SSD health, blue screen analysis, startup time). English or French.
